The saying "giving your '100%'" is quite common, but what does that exactly mean? This project attempted to quantify this effort for NFL running backs. For each running back and utilizing Big Data Bowl tracking data, we graphed acceleration-speed (A-S) profiles. Using quantitative generalized additive modeling (QGAM), we found the highest percentiles of acceleration for each given speed. Effort is then defined by how often and close a player comes to this threshold. We also expanded this analysis to wide receivers. For more results and information, please watch the video attached!
